name: VS Code
description: Editor for hand-written HTML, SCSS and JavaScript, and for reading through diffs.

name: Cursor
description: AI-first fork of VS Code, part of my daily AI toolkit. My larger builds run through Claude Code instead.

name: Claude Code
description: The agent I build DevStash with. I set the direction and specs, it writes the code, and I review and test every change.

name: Claude
description: Planning, architecture questions and writing feedback, before any code gets written.

name: GitHub Copilot
description: Inline AI suggestions inside the editor, part of my daily workflow.

name: ChatGPT
description: General-purpose AI assistant in my daily toolkit.

name: Perplexity
description: AI search that cites its sources, so every answer comes with pages I can check.

name: Groq
description: Fast LLM API behind my n8n workflows and the DevStash AI content pipeline. Chained calls, structured output, and a close eye on per-minute rate limits.

name: Ollama
description: Runs open-weight models locally for offline experiments, with nothing leaving the machine.

name: Git Bash (Windows Terminal)
description: Git Bash inside Windows Terminal: Unix-style tooling on a Windows machine.

name: Figma
description: UX is what pulled me toward the web, and Figma is where I tried designing before ending up on the front-end side.

name: PageSpeed Insights
description: The first thing I open for a slow landing page: real-user Core Web Vitals plus a Lighthouse run. I used it to fix LCP and CLS on PPC pages at Chetu.

name: WAVE
description: Accessibility checker I ran on Chetu's marketing pages to catch contrast, alt-text and structure problems before they shipped.

name: n8n
description: Self-hosted workflow automation. Runs my job-application workflow: Google Sheets as the contact list, Groq for personalised emails, Gmail for sending.

name: GitHub & Actions
description: Every project's repo. Actions runs type checks, lint, unit tests and the responsive QA suite before anything reaches production.

name: Playwright
description: Browser tests for DevStash: a responsive suite from 200px to 1440px, accessibility checks with axe, and smoke tests against production after each deploy.

name: Vercel
description: Hosts devstash.me. Every push to the dev branch gets a staging deploy I review before anything goes live.

name: Supabase
description: Postgres database and auth behind Praxis, my frontend interview-prep platform.

name: Cloudflare
description: DNS for devstash.me, set to DNS-only (grey cloud) so Vercel serves the site directly.

name: pnpm
description: Package manager on every project: fast installs from one shared store, and strict about undeclared dependencies.
